report.summary: KYC onboarding failures since 13:50 UTC were caused by downstream 504 Gateway Timeouts from the external kyc-vendor during PAN verification calls. This exhausted the kyc-service worker pool (64/64 busy), causing request rejections, p99 latency spikes up to 30s, and elevated error rates in both kyc-service and mobile-bff.

ranked_hypotheses.title: External KYC Vendor Degradation / Timeouts Causing Worker Pool Exhaustion

supporting.note: Shows kyc-vendor returning 504 Gateway Timeouts after 30000ms starting at 13:50:15 UTC.
Latency p99 anomaly onset at 13:51:00 UTC, peaking at ~30.7s.
Error rate anomaly onset at 13:52:00 UTC, peaking over 42%.
Verification worker pool exhausted (64/64 busy) error logs starting at 13:53:00 UTC.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Recent Code Deployment Introduced Blocking or Timeout Behavior

supporting.note: kyc-service v5.3.0 deployed a new PAN verification screen flow approximately 20 hours prior.

contradicting.note: The deploy occurred ~20 hours prior to the error anomaly onset without prior symptoms, strongly implying external triggers.

facts.text: kyc-service error rate percentage anomaly started at 13:52:00 UTC and peaked at 42.72%.
kyc-service p99 latency anomaly started at 13:51:00 UTC and peaked at 30,701ms.
kyc-vendor returned 504 Gateway Timeout after 30000ms starting at 13:50:15 UTC.
kyc-service verification worker pool became exhausted (64/64 busy) at 13:53:00 UTC.
mobile-bff error rate anomaly started at 13:52:00 UTC.

assumptions: The external vendor kyc-vendor experienced internal capacity degradation or routing failures leading to 30-second timeouts.
Rigid worker pool sizing and retry policies in kyc-service amplified the cascading failure by holding threads hostage.
evidence_gaps: Server-side logs and infrastructure metrics from kyc-vendor are unavailable due to it being an external vendor.

timeline.event: First recorded kyc-vendor 504 Gateway Timeout on PAN verification
kyc-service and mobile-bff error rate anomaly onset
kyc-service verification worker pool exhausted (64/64 busy)

recommended_actions.action: Contact kyc-vendor support to report widespread 504 Gateway Timeouts on POST /v2/pan/verify.
recommended_actions.rationale: Vendor-side timeouts are the primary driver of internal worker thread exhaustion.

recommended_actions.action: Implement circuit breakers and fast-fail fallbacks in kyc-service when vendor calls stall.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents worker threads from getting blocked for 30 seconds and saturating the verification pool.

recommended_actions.action: Increase kyc-service verification worker pool size and decouple verification tasks using an asynchronous model.
recommended_actions.rationale: Mitigates thread starvation under similar future vendor slowdowns.

recommended_actions.action: Onboard a secondary backup KYC vendor for automatic traffic failover.
recommended_actions.rationale: Protects user onboarding flow against single third-party vendor outages.
